items.name: Cube Against Cancer Hawaii 2027
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png) ### Oahu's annual winter competition is here! --- * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 9:50 AM. --- **This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to [Kapiʻolani Medical Center for Women & Children](https://www.hawaiipacifichealth.org/locations/kapiolani/). See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerHawaii2027#83173-cube-against-cancer) tab for more information.** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbEF2IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8251573b328b2e062c683f33bccc9e924b923d20/170aa7c0467a35c79617e6895b87b17f34553486.png)
